ten_cong_ty: Ngân hàng TMCP Sài Gòn - Hà Nội (SHB)
mo_ta_cong_viec:
Develop automation testing strategies and plans aligned with system requirements and project objectives.
Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reusable automation frameworks.
Develop test scripts for UI, API, Integration, and Contract Testing.
Perform Performance Testing, including developing performance, load, and stress testing scenarios; analyzing bottlenecks and proposing system optimization solutions.
Integrate automation testing into CI/CD pipelines to ensure fast feedback for development teams.
Analyze test results, troubleshoot issues, and optimize the stability and reliability of the automation test suite.
Collaborate with Developers, BAs, and QAs throughout the software development lifecycle.
Research, recommend, and implement new automation technologies and tools.
For Senior level: Provide guidance, mentoring, and support to enhance the team's technical capabilities.
yeu_cau:
Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field from reputable universities, such as Banking Academy of Vietnam, Hanoi University of Science and Technology, Posts and Telecommunications Institute of Technology, Vietnam National University, University of Technology, Thuongmai University, University of Economics, or reputable universities overseas.
Experience
Mid-level: At least 3 years of QA experience, including a minimum of 2 years in automation testing.
Senior-level: At least 5 years of experience, with the ability to design automation frameworks and/or lead automation testing initiatives.
Technical Expertise
Proficient in Java with a strong understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, and design patterns.
Strong experience in UI/API automation testing.
Strong expertise in Performance Testing.
Good understanding of CI/CD, microservices, databases, and message queues.
Experience with tools such as Serenity BDD, Selenium, Jenkins, and Docker is a plus.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
Soft Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive mindset and strong sense of ownership.
Good communication and teamwork skills.
Passion for technology and a strong interest in test automation.
Candidates with experience in the finance/banking industry are preferred.
quyen_loi:
1. Attractive Compensation & Benefits
Competitive monthly salary and allowances aligned with the market.
Performance-based year-end bonus.
Additional bonuses for birthdays, public holidays, Tet, and employee welfare programs.
Comprehensive healthcare package, including annual health check-ups and SHB Care health insurance.
Team-building activities, internal cultural and sports events to foster employee engagement.
Company trips twice a year.
2. Modern & Innovative Working Environment
A young, dynamic, and modern workplace that encourages creativity and innovation.
An empowering work culture with autonomy, flexibility, and a forward-thinking mindset.
Diverse learning and development programs to support both professional and personal growth.
